About Me

{/* Left: your bio pulled from résumé/LinkedIn About */}

I’m a Running Start student at SPSCC pursuing an A.A. in Computer Science, and an aspiring Electrical & Computer Engineer. Over the past three years, I’ve captained FRC Team 4450, founded FIRST STEP ORG to mentor 60+ students, and built AI-powered web apps like SignalSync. I thrive at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and community outreach.

Whether wiring a robot’s control system in Java, training a CNN in Python, or leading rookie workshops, I love solving complex problems and empowering others to explore STEM.
